cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

mechanism: A professionally separates the practical fare from the escalating relational price of an offered lift.
confusable: D214 prices every offer; D238 explicitly keeps both practical and growing emotional prices.
comparison: Transport and broken contact differ from clothing and public judgment.
seedUse: Keep petrol/conversation split but make the increased second price a concrete new acknowledgment, not a price-rising slogan.
